Maya: quick q — a major retail customer just asked for a 99.9% latency SLA for embeddings search (p95 < 100ms). They said they'll consolidate spend if we can promise it. This would push Dedicated adoption but requires infra changes. Should we re-score RICE for Q3? cc @Owen @Liam
Owen: can you paste the ask + projected $ ARR? need numbers to update 'Impact' and 'Reach'.
Maya: they estimate $1.2M ARR if we meet SLA and migrate 3 products. Reach = 3 customers initially, then org-wide.
Liam: on effort — Dedicated + autoscale changes ~3 sprints infra + 1 sprint platform work. Risk = medium (scheduling, kernel tuning).
Sophia: RICE thinking: Reach 3, Impact 9, Confidence 60%, Effort 8 -> RICE = (3*9*0.6)/8 = 2.025. But if we consider downstream revenue multiplier, Impact maybe 12.
Eva: meta: are we optimizing for Hosted perf (batching/kv cache) vs Dedicated product? Different sequencing: cheaper to optimize hosted first (lower effort) but dedicated gives stronger sales signal.
Maya: Hosted opt: quick wins (3 weeks) but won't hit 99.9 p95; Dedicated is heavier but durable.
Owen: propose two options: A) short-term hosted perf sprint (low effort, short reach) B) dedicated SLA initiative (high effort, high impact). We should reweight RICE w/ company KPI: revenue and sales acceleration.
Liam: vote A for Q3 quick wins, but hedge by starting Dedicated proof-of-concept in parallel (spike 2 weeks).
Sophia: agree. Launch criteria for Hosted opt: p95 < 150ms on benchmark + regression tests + docs + customer pilot. For Dedicated: GA internal SLA testbed + autoscale policy + BOM for customers.
Eva: assign owners? Maya -> host perf, Liam -> Dedicated spike, Owen -> update RICE spreadsheet and recalc by EOD.
Release-bot: new file created: /roadmap/q3/rice-scores/1974123456-sla-vs-velocity-prio-v1.xlsx
Maya: thanks all :thumbsup: I'll post a short spec and TODOs by EOD.
